title: A co-change report sets the split lines of the large modules
goal: kb/_self/reports/modules.md shows, for kbgit.py, benchmarks.py, kbfacts.py, factdiff.py and backlog.py, how often each section changed alone and together with the others across git history, and gives each module one Verdict line: split along named boundaries, or keep whole with the reason
notes: A one-off analysis from git log -L or per-commit hunk ranges, not a permanent tool. Only kbgit.py and benchmarks.py are split in this sprint; a verdict to split kbfacts.py, factdiff.py or backlog.py becomes a story for a later sprint.
